einzeiler: Nikolai Fedorov's quest to defeat death, AI safeguards, and the MAGA movement's future.
kurzfassung: Glenn discusses Nikolai Fedorov's historical quest to defeat death and the modern pursuit of this goal by powerful figures. The episode covers the need for AI safeguards alongside data center expansion to compete with China. Additionally, topics include business success stories, recent cultural controversies, and an interview with Victor Davis Hanson on the future of MAGA.
stichpunkte: Nikolai Fedorov and the historical pursuit to defeat death
Balancing AI data center expansion with human-controlled safeguards
Success stories of modern billion-dollar businesses
The controversy surrounding Macklemore's removal from the Ed Sheeran tour
Sydney Sweeney's recent advertising campaign controversy
Victor Davis Hanson on the future of the MAGA movement after Trump
beschreibung:
Glenn tells the story of a 19th-century librarian, Nikolai Fedorov, who claimed humanity's number-one goal was to defeat death, an idea that has since been carried throughout history and is still being chased by powerful men today. Glenn warns that the danger isn’t wanting to cure death, but it lies in what the people who are steering the ship will do to anybody who stands in their way. Glenn discusses the Pro-Human Assembly happening in Washington, hosted by Bernie Sanders and Steve Bannon, and argues that the U.S. must simultaneously build data centers to beat China in the AI race and demand human-controlled safeguards like off switches and independent inspectors. Is the American dream of starting a business still obtainable? Glenn shares success stories of multiple businesses that started from the ground up and are now worth billions. Rapper Macklemore has been removed as the opening act of the Ed Sheeran tour after using the stage to preach about Palestine, all because one father decided to take a stand against the indoctrination. Glenn and Jason discuss the latest controversy surrounding Sydney Sweeney and her recent ad campaign. Glenn speaks with Victor Davis Hanson about the future of the MAGA movement after President Trump leaves the Oval Office.
